Example inputs for call_episomal_ecdna()

Source: R/data.R
ex_caller_inputs.Rd

A small, self-contained toy dataset describing a textbook episomal EGFR ecDNA on chr7 in a fictional sample "EXAMPLE01": a focal amplification bounded by a high variant-fraction duplication (the circularisation junction), excised from otherwise diploid flanks and leaving a low-VF deletion "excision scar". The data are synthetic (no patient data) so the example runs anywhere in seconds and call_episomal_ecdna() flags the amplicon as episomal.

Usage

ex_caller_inputs

Format

A named list of four GenomicRanges::GRanges objects, matching the four required arguments of call_episomal_ecdna():

ecdna_gr

AmpliconArchitect-style ecDNA amplicon region; metadata ID, WGS_ID.

breakpoints_gr

PURPLE-style SV breakpoints; metadata WGS_ID, event, svclass, PURPLE_AF, PURPLE_JCN, VF, PURPLE_CN, insLen, HOMLEN.

cnv_gr

PURPLE-style allele-specific copy-number segments; metadata sample, copyNumber, ploidy, majorAlleleCopyNumber, minorAlleleCopyNumber.

cancer_genes_gr

Cancer-gene loci (EGFR) with a gene column.

Source

Synthetic; generated by data-raw/make_example_data.R.

See also

call_episomal_ecdna(), ex_plot_inputs

Examples

res <- call_episomal_ecdna(
  ex_caller_inputs$ecdna_gr, ex_caller_inputs$breakpoints_gr,
  ex_caller_inputs$cnv_gr,   ex_caller_inputs$cancer_genes_gr
)
#> Loading required namespace: GenomeInfoDb
res$episomal
#> [1] "TRUE" "TRUE" "TRUE" "TRUE"
